Provider: Fondazione Agnese e Agostino Maletti

Submission deadline: 18 September 2026

For the school year 2026/27, the Agnese and Agostino Maletti Foundation has set up a number of scholarships in the form of grants and/or study loans to be repaid, intended for Italian students enrolling in courses at the Academy of Architecture in Mendrisio. Applications from interested parties must be submitted using the application form issued by the Foundation and must be received at the Foundation's offices no later than Friday 18 September 2026 at 5 p.m.
